n: Embodied machine learning classroom activities (Raspberry Pi Foundation write-up)
t: Hands-on machine learning activities with drawings and micro:bit movement.
steps: Find the Raspberry Pi Foundation blog post on embodied machine learning.
Gather micro:bit boards for the gesture activities.
Open micro:bit CreateAI or the ML-Machine tool linked from the post.
Print prompt cards for the ethics talk.
Test a moving or still model with about 20 examples.
Run the activity and discuss what the model got wrong.
